stem: A hazard has been temporarily controlled with a barrier, but the permanent correction is still pending. What should the handoff communicate?
choices: Nothing, because the barrier means the issue is closed
The remaining hazard, temporary control, restrictions, responsible party and permanent-correction status
Only the date the barrier was installed
That the next shift may remove the barrier if it is inconvenient
rationale: Temporary control does not erase the underlying hazard. The handoff must preserve the restriction, ownership and correction status.
